title: The Lamb and the Dove
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: One day John the Baptist saw Jesus coming toward him. John called out, “Look! The Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!”
Why a Lamb? Long ago, people gave Heavenly Father a perfect little lamb. It showed they were sorry for the wrong things they did.
Jesus is Heavenly Father’s perfect gift. He takes away our wrong things when we are sorry.
p2: John told everyone what he had seen. The Holy Ghost came down from heaven like a dove and stayed on Jesus. That was the sign Heavenly Father had promised John.
So John spoke up: “This is the Son of God!” Tonight, tell someone you love Jesus, just like John did.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
